name: lotwork
description: Local dev project manager - start/stop projects, manage ports, custom localhost domains via Caddy

scripts.build:gui: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Install-Module -Name ps2exe -Scope CurrentUser -Force; Invoke-ps2exe -inputFile scripts/gui.ps1 -outputFile lotwork-control.exe -iconFile lotwork.ico -noConsole -title lotwork -product lotwork -description 'lotwork Local Project Manager'"
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:gui
